editions.distributor_group: 野村證券 (agency list of ahp814)
editions.basis: Own rate page (ahp814) and agency list. It shows the same 定期支払コース/任意受取コース numbers as ahp805 wherever both publish one, but only that course (no 積立金増加コース), and it left the 10-year columns blank until 2026-10-01 where ahp805 published them. scripts/met.py checks the current numbers on every run; no separate series is stored.

notes: The rate pages are a React app: the HTML holds no numbers. The numbers come from POST https://www.metlife.co.jp/annuityproduct/v1/applications/newpolicyinfo (public, no login); the request shape was read from the site's own JavaScript bundle and the bank-window page opened in the built-in browser to confirm it renders the same figures. scripts/met.py sends the same requests with urllib.

Plans: teiki_* = 定期支払コース/任意受取コース, zoukai_* = 積立金増加コース (rate-reset type only), *_boost = the 上乗せ 積立利率 for large premiums (USD 400,000 / AUD 500,000 / JPY 50,000,000 or more, also reached by premium paid in yen or foreign currency of that size via the rider), teiki_noreset = 利率更改なし型 基準利率 (lifetime guarantee, no term).

crediting_rate = 積立利率 of the 利率更改あり型, term_years is the 利率保証期間. After the guarantee period the rate is reset; the boost does not carry over to the reset rate. base_rate = 基準利率 of the 利率更改なし型. The actual 積増率 of the no-reset type depends on currency, contract age, sex, amount and 基準利率 and is only in the quotation, so it is not collected.

A blank value in the API (or '-' on the page) is stored as status not_offered. For USD 5 years that is every window before 2026-10-01. AUD is offered for 10 years only, so AUD 5 and 20 years are absent from the CSVs, and JPY 20 years likewise. Some distributors do not offer every currency or term.

effective_date is the first day of the half-month contract window the rate applies to (1st-15th, 16th-end). The API returns history from 2026-04-01, the launch date; no earlier window exists. The API also gives serviceOpenDate 2026/10/01 for ahp805, probably a page-set date (5-year terms start then), not the launch.
The popup history requests are keyed by start year and return overlapping windows; the collector requests every year and requires the overlaps to agree.
has_mva is true: the page publishes 基準指標金利 'for the market value adjustment rate on cancellation or reduction' (解約時・減額時の市場価格調整率). The formula and the 基準指標金利 series are not collected.
The brochure and policy conditions were not downloaded. The brochure PDFs listed under documents are per distributor group (p806 common for USD/AUD/JPY, p805 USD/JPY, みずほ銀行, みずほ信託銀行, みずほ証券, 三菱UFJ銀行).
Distributors are the agency list of ahp805 (retrieved 2026-11-17). Distributor-specific product names are only partly known from the insurer list (ガーデン ザ ギフトⅡ).
The same rate list also has アクティブデザイン, ウェルスデザインⅡ and USドル建IS終身保険 (ドルスマート); not tracked here.

Plan names shortened 2026-11-17: 'Payout courses' = 定期支払コース and 任意受取コース (one rate table); 'large-premium boost' = 積立利率（上乗せ）, the higher rate for large premiums; 'no reset (rate for life)' = 利率更改なし型 基準利率.

Launch date: 2026-04-01, from MetLife's release of 2026-03-30 (PR TIMES mirror; metlife.co.jp answers 403 to scripts): 「4月1日より、一時払終身保険「サニーガーデン プライム」を発売します」, sold at 金融機関代理店 from that day. 2026-07-01 is only the start of the direct-sales and agency channels, and 2026-10-01 (the API serviceOpenDate) is when USD 5-year terms appear; neither is the launch. Retrieved 2026-11-17.
notes_en: Rate history starts on 1 April 2026; the insurer publishes nothing earlier, and 5-year USD terms only appear from October 2026.
Rates are set for half-month contract windows and cover USD (5, 10 and 20 years), AUD (10 years) and JPY (5 and 10 years).
Higher boosted rates for large premiums are collected; the boost does not carry over to the rate after the guarantee period resets.
The market value adjustment formula and reference rates are not collected, and the brochures and conditions have not been read.
Launched 1 April 2026 at banks (insurer's release); direct and agency sales began in July 2026. Several distributor-specific names sit on the same rates and are not tracked separately.

verification.method: A reproducible random sample (scripts/recheck_candidates_b.py, seed recheck-sample:met-sunny-garden-prime; every metric/plan/currency group, at least 10% per metric/plan, at least 20 rows) plus every outlier (a value outside 0-15%, more than 3 standard deviations from its series mean, or more than 1pp from the previous point) was compared with its saved snapshot by an independent parser; all checked rows matched. A pass over every row also matched.
verification.note: Rows with a retrieved_date after verified_through have not been re-checked. The snapshots carry MetLife's API field names, not on-page labels; values match under the collector's reading of those names, which was not re-confirmed offline.
